title: Worker Handoff
description: Bounded packet identifying one Worker attempt. Carries paths and hashes, never copies of documents.
$comment: Every property appears in required at every level, matching the strict structured-output rules the result contracts must follow. Optional fields are nullable, never absent, so a Worker never has to guess whether a missing key means empty or unset.

mode.description: Role-specific operating mode. discovery uses challenge. planner uses plan-write. implementer uses build. reviewer uses plan-check, audit, initial, incremental, or final.

worktree.description: Absolute root the Worker operates in. After approval this is the Run's isolated worktree. Before approval, and for an audit, no worktree exists yet: it is the primary checkout, and the read-only tool boundary is what keeps it safe.

baseSha.description: The commit the work is anchored to. After approval, the immutable SHA the worktree was created from. Before approval, the observed HEAD, recorded so a later phase can tell whether the repository moved during discovery.

snapshotHash.description: Hash of the repository subject at handoff time. Reused to detect a changed Review Subject.

taskIds.description: Plan task identifiers this attempt owns. Empty for read-only roles that own no task.

writeSet.description: Paths this attempt may modify. Empty means read-only.

artifacts.description: Canonical documents the Worker must read from disk.

pendingFindingIds.description: Findings this attempt must address. Null outside remediation and delta review.

notes.description: Correction notes carried forward from the previous attempt of the same role. Binding for the rest of that session.

validationCommands.description: Required Project Profile commands relevant to this attempt. Null for roles that run none.
